law_current: Charities Act 2011 (c.25) is the current governing statute for charities in England & Wales, as amended by the Charities Act 2022 (c.6); further commencement regulations (e.g. SI 2025/1191, The Charities Act 2022 (Commencement No. 4 and Saving Provision) Regulations 2025) are bringing 2022 provisions into force in 2025. The entity types named (registered charity, CLG, charitable trust) are all current.
fee_plausible: Charity Commission registration is free (mandatory above £5,000 income; the row's 'Registration fee (USD): 0' is correct). The ~£12 Companies House online incorporation fee for a CLG was the official rate until 1 Feb 2026, from which the digital incorporation filing fee rises to £100 (gov.uk news, 30 Oct 2025). Plausible at row time, needs update.
time_plausible: The Charity Commission's published target is 30 working days for registration; the row's ~8-12 weeks / 3-6 months is a conservative, plausible allowance including governing document, CLG incorporation and application.
presence_supported: Supported with nuance: no residency or citizenship requirement for trustees (confirmed by Charity Commission guidance and current legal Q&A), and the whole application is online, so a remote AU-resident founder can register; however the charity must be based in England/Wales - a UK postal address and UK management and control are required (Charity Commission registration rules; Finance Act 2010 management-and-control test for tax reliefs). The row's 'yes' verdict is defensible; the practical requirement (UK address + UK-based control) is already stated in the row.
corrections: The ~£12 Companies House online incorporation fee for a CLG rises to £100 from 1 Feb 2026 under the fee changes announced 30 Oct 2025. The row's source URL https://www.gov.uk/how-to-register-charity is now a 404; the current official page is https://www.gov.uk/setting-up-charity/register-your-charity. The Charities Act 2011 should be noted as amended by the Charities Act 2022, with commencement regulations in force from 2025.
